description_en: Retrieves a list of application instances
kebab_example: aliyun sae describe-application-instances --app-id d700e680-aa4d-4ec1-afc2-6566b5ff0000 --group-id b2a8a925-477a-4ed7-b825-d5e225000000 --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --reverse true --instance-id demo-faaca66c-5959-45cc-b3bf-d26093b2e9c0000000 --pipeline-id 85750d48-6cfc-4dbf-8ea0-840397000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeApplicationInstances

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application group. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/126249.html operation to get the ID
parameters.help_zh: 应用分组ID。需要调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/126249.html接口获取
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10. The value must be in the range (0, 1000000000)
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。默认为10，取值范围(0,1000000000)
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the sort order of the application instances. Instances are sorted first by running status, and then by instance ID. Valid values:

true: The instances are sorted in descending order.

false: The instances are sorted in ascending order.

Instance statuses in ascending order:

Error: An error occurred during instance startup.

CrashLoopBackOff: The container fails to start and enters a crash-restart loop.

ErrImagePull: An error occurred while pulling the container image for the instance.

ImagePullBackOff: The system is repeatedly trying and failing to pull the container image.

Pending: The instance is waiting to be scheduled.

Unknown: An unknown exception occurred.

Terminating: The instance is being terminated.

NotFound: The instance cannot be found.

PodInitializing: The instance is being initialized.

Init:0/1: The instance is being initialized.

Running: The instance is running
parameters.help_zh:
根据应用实例运行状态对其进行排序。如果状态相同，则按照实例ID排序。取值说明如下：

true：按倒序排序。
false：按正序排序。

实例正序排列如下：

Error：实例启动过程中出错。
CrashLoopBackOff：容器无法启动，在启动过程中出错，重启后又出错。
ErrImagePull：拉取实例中的容器镜像出错。
ImagePullBackOff：无法获取容器镜像。
Pending：实例等待调度中。
Unknown：未知异常。
Terminating：终止实例接入中。
NotFound：无法找到实例。
PodInitializing：实例初始化中。
Init:0/1：实例初始化。
Running：实例运行中
parameters.name: reverse

parameters.help_en: The batch ID. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/126617.html operation to get the ID
parameters.name: pipeline_id
